description.blurb: S/2020 S 2 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2020 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2020 S 2 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 17.9 million km in 897.6 days. It has an inclination of 170.7° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.152.
